versos.hebraico: וַתִּשָּׂא֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַֽיִּתְּנ֖וּ אֶת־קוֹלָ֑ם וַיִּבְכּ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם בַּלַּ֥יְלָה הַהֽוּא׃

controles.web: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
controles.kjv: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
controles.livre: Então toda a congregação levantaram grito, e deram vozes: e o povo chorou aquela noite.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּלֹּ֨נוּ֙ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵהֶ֜ם כָּל־הָעֵדָ֗ה לוּ־מַ֨תְנוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם א֛וֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה לוּ־מָֽתְנוּ׃

controles.web: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!
controles.kjv: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
controles.livre: E queixaram-se contra Moisés e contra Arão todos os filhos de Israel; e disse-lhes toda a multidão: Melhor seria se tivéssemos morrido na terra do Egito; ou melhor seria se tivéssemos morrido neste deserto!

versos.hebraico: וְלָמָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה מֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜נוּ אֶל־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לִנְפֹּ֣ל בַּחֶ֔רֶב נָשֵׁ֥ינוּ וְטַפֵּ֖נוּ יִהְי֣וּ לָבַ֑ז הֲל֧וֹא ט֦וֹב לָ֖נוּ שׁ֥וּב מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃

controles.web: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
controles.kjv: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
controles.livre: E por que nos traze o SENHOR a esta terra para cair à espada e que nossas mulheres e nossos meninos sejam por presa? não nos seria melhor voltarmos ao Egito?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֑יו נִתְּנָ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְנָשׁ֥וּבָה מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃

controles.web: They said one to another, “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.”
controles.kjv: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
controles.livre: E diziam um ao outro: Façamos um capitão, e voltemos ao Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפֹּ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם לִפְנֵ֕י כָּל־קְהַ֥ל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Então Moisés e Arão caíram sobre seus rostos diante de toda a multidão da congregação dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֗וּן וְכָלֵב֙ בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה מִן־הַתָּרִ֖ים אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ קָרְע֖וּ בִּגְדֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
controles.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
controles.livre: E Josué filho de Num, e Calebe filho de Jefoné, que eram dos que haviam reconhecido a terra, rasgaram suas roupas;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבַ֤רְנוּ בָהּ֙ לָת֣וּר אֹתָ֔הּ טוֹבָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.
controles.kjv: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
controles.livre: E falaram a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: A terra por de onde passamos para reconhecê-la, é terra em grande maneira boa.

versos.hebraico: אִם־חָפֵ֥ץ בָּ֨נוּ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְהֵבִ֤יא אֹתָ֨נוּ֙ אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את וּנְתָנָ֖הּ לָ֑נוּ אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הִ֛וא זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃

controles.web: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.
controles.kjv: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
controles.livre: Se o SENHOR se agradar de nós, ele nos porá nesta terra, e a entregará a nós; terra que flui leite e mel.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ךְ בַּֽיהוָה֮ אַל־תִּמְרֹדוּ֒ וְאַתֶּ֗ם אַל־תִּֽירְאוּ֙ אֶת־עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י לַחְמֵ֖נוּ הֵ֑ם סָ֣ר צִלָּ֧ם מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֛ם וַֽיהוָ֥ה אִתָּ֖נוּ אַל־תִּירָאֻֽם׃

controles.web: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”
controles.kjv: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.
controles.livre: Portanto, não sejais rebeldes contra o SENHOR, nem temais ao povo desta terra, porque nosso pão são: seu amparo se afastou deles, e conosco está o SENHOR: não os temais.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִרְגּ֥וֹם אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲבָנִ֑ים וּכְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֗ה נִרְאָה֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

controles.web: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones.   Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
controles.livre: Então toda a multidão falou de apedrejá-los com pedras. Mas a glória do SENHOR se mostrou no tabernáculo do testemunho a todos os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד־אָ֥נָה יְנַאֲצֻ֖נִי הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה וְעַד־אָ֨נָה֙ לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ בִ֔י בְּכֹל֙ הָֽאֹת֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Até quando me há de irritar este povo? até quando não me há de crer com todos os sinais que fiz em meio deles?.

versos.hebraico: אַכֶּ֥נּוּ בַדֶּ֖בֶר וְאוֹרִשֶׁ֑נּוּ וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֹֽתְךָ֔ לְגוֹי־גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
controles.kjv: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
controles.livre: Eu lhe ferirei de mortandade, e o destruirei, e a ti te porei sobre gente grande e mais forte que eles.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּֽי־הֶעֱלִ֧יתָ בְכֹחֲךָ֛ אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה מִקִּרְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
controles.livre: E Moisés respondeu ao SENHOR: Logo os egípcios o ouvirão, porque do meio deles tiraste a este povo com tua força:

versos.hebraico: וְאָמְר֗וּ אֶל־יוֹשֵׁב֮ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּאת֒ שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּקֶ֖רֶב הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־עַ֨יִן בְּעַ֜יִן נִרְאָ֣ה׀ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וַעֲנָֽנְךָ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עֲלֵהֶ֔ם וּבְעַמֻּ֣ד עָנָ֗ן אַתָּ֨ה הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִפְנֵיהֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּבְעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה׃

controles.web: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are in the midst of this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
controles.kjv: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
controles.livre: E o dirão aos habitantes desta terra; os quais ouviram que tu, ó SENHOR, estavas em meio deste povo, que olho a olho aparecias tu, ó SENHOR, e que tua nuvem estava sobre eles, e que de dia ias diante deles em coluna de nuvem, e de noite em coluna de fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵמַתָּ֛ה אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶֽת־שִׁמְעֲךָ֖ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,
controles.kjv: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
controles.livre: E que fizeste morrer a este povo como a um homem: e as nações que houverem ouvido tua fama falarão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: מִבִּלְתִּ֞י יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהוָ֗ה לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לָהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁחָטֵ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
controles.kjv: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
controles.livre: Porque não pôde o SENHOR meter este povo na terra da qual lhes havia jurado, os matou no deserto.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֕ה יִגְדַּל־נָ֖א כֹּ֣חַ אֲדֹנָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,
controles.kjv: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
controles.livre: Agora, pois, eu te rogo que seja engrandecida a força do Senhor, como o falaste, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְרַב־חֶ֔סֶד נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֖ן וָפָ֑שַׁע וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֞ד עֲוֺ֤ן אָבוֹת֙ עַל־בָּנִ֔ים עַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִֽים׃

controles.web: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’
controles.kjv: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
controles.livre: O SENHOR, tardio de ira e grande em misericórdia, que perdoa a iniquidade e a rebelião, e deixa impune o culpado; que visita a maldade dos pais sobre os filhos até a terceira geração e até a quarta.

versos.hebraico: סְלַֽח־נָ֗א לַעֲוֺ֛ן הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה כְּגֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ וְכַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־הֵֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and according as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”
controles.kjv: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
controles.livre: Perdoa agora a iniquidade deste povo segundo a grandeza de tua misericórdia, e como perdoaste a este povo desde Egito até aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה סָלַ֖חְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word:
controles.kjv: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR disse: Eu o perdoei conforme tu dito:

versos.hebraico: וְאוּלָ֖ם חַי־אָ֑נִי וְיִמָּלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory;
controles.kjv: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.
controles.livre: Mas, certamente vivo eu e minha glória inche toda a terra,

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כָל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָרֹאִ֤ים אֶת־כְּבֹדִי֙ וְאֶת־אֹ֣תֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתִי בְמִצְרַ֖יִם וּבַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֹתִ֗י זֶ֚ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּקוֹלִֽי׃

controles.web: because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;
controles.kjv: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
controles.livre: Que todos os que viram minha glória e meus sinais que fiz no Egito e no deserto, e me tentaram já dez vezes, e não ouviram minha voz,

versos.hebraico: אִם־יִרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֑ם וְכָל־מְנַאֲצַ֖י לֹ֥א יִרְאֽוּהָ׃

controles.web: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.
controles.kjv: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
controles.livre: Não verão a terra da qual jurei a seus pais: não, nenhum dos que me irritaram a verá.

versos.hebraico: וְעַבְדִּ֣י כָלֵ֗ב עֵ֣קֶב הָֽיְתָ֞ה ר֤וּחַ אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וַיְמַלֵּ֖א אַחֲרָ֑י וַהֲבִֽיאֹתִ֗יו אֶל־הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣א שָׁ֔מָּה וְזַרְע֖וֹ יוֹרִשֶֽׁנָּה׃

controles.web: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His seed shall possess it.
controles.kjv: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
controles.livre: Porém meu servo Calebe, porquanto houve nele outro espírito, e cumpriu de ir após mim, eu o porei na terra onde entrou e sua descendência a receberá em herança.

versos.hebraico: וְהָֽעֲמָלֵקִ֥י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּעֵ֑מֶק מָחָ֗ר פְּנ֨וּ וּסְע֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־סֽוּף׃פ

controles.web: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn, and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”
controles.kjv: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
controles.livre: Agora bem, os amalequitas e os cananeus habitam no vale; voltai-vos amanhã, e parti-vos ao deserto, caminho do mar Vermelho.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: עַד־מָתַ֗י לָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה מַלִּינִ֖ים עָלָ֑י אֶת־תְּלֻנּ֞וֹת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧מָּה מַלִּינִ֛ים עָלַ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃

controles.web: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
controles.kjv: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
controles.livre: Até quando ouvirei esta depravada multidão que murmura contra mim, as queixas dos filhos de Israel, que de mim se queixam?

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם חַי־אָ֨נִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה אִם־לֹ֕א כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם בְּאָזְנָ֑י כֵּ֖ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you.
controles.kjv: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
controles.livre: Dize-lhes: Vivo eu, diz o SENHOR, que segundo falastes a meus ouvidos, assim farei eu convosco:

versos.hebraico: בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ֠זֶּה יִפְּל֨וּ פִגְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְכָל־פְּקֻדֵיכֶם֙ לְכָל־מִסְפַּרְכֶ֔ם מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲלִֽינֹתֶ֖ם עָלָֽי׃

controles.web: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,
controles.kjv: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
controles.livre: Neste deserto cairão vossos corpos; todos vossos contados segundo toda vossa contagem, de vinte anos acima, os quais murmurastes contra mim;

versos.hebraico: אִם־אַתֶּם֙ תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת־יָדִ֔י לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּ֑הּ כִּ֚י אִם־כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃

controles.web: surely you shall not come into the land, concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.kjv: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
controles.livre: Vós à verdade não entrareis na terra, pela qual levantei minha mão de fazer-vos habitar nela; exceto a Calebe filho de Jefoné, e a Josué filho de Num.

versos.hebraico: וְטַ֨פְּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהֵבֵיאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְאַסְתֶּ֖ם בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: But your little ones, that you said should be captured or killed, them I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.
controles.kjv: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
controles.livre: Mas vossos meninos, dos quais dissestes que seriam por presa, eu os introduzirei, e eles conhecerão a terra que vós desprezastes.

versos.hebraico: וּפִגְרֵיכֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֑ם יִפְּל֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.
controles.kjv: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
controles.livre: E quanto a vós, vossos corpos cairão neste deserto.

versos.hebraico: וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם יִהְי֨וּ רֹעִ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־זְנוּתֵיכֶ֑ם עַד־תֹּ֥ם פִּגְרֵיכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.
controles.kjv: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
controles.livre: E vossos filhos andarão pastoreando no deserto quarenta anos, e eles levarão vossas prostituições, até que vossos corpos sejam consumidos no deserto.

versos.hebraico: בְּמִסְפַּ֨ר הַיָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־תַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ֮ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים יוֹם֒ י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֞ה י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֗ה תִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־תְּנוּאָתִֽי׃

controles.web: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
controles.kjv: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
controles.livre: Conforme o número dos dias, dos quarenta dias em que reconhecestes a terra, levareis vossas iniquidades quarenta anos, ano por cada dia; e conhecereis meu castigo.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ דִּבַּרְתִּי֒ אִם־לֹ֣א׀ זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֗ה לְכָל־הָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את הַנּוֹעָדִ֖ים עָלָ֑י בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה יִתַּ֖מּוּ וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֻֽתוּ׃

controles.web: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation, who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”
controles.kjv: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
controles.livre: Eu sou o SENHOR falei; assim farei a toda esta multidão perversa que se juntou contra mim; neste deserto serão consumidos, e ali morrerão.

versos.hebraico: וְהָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּשֻׁ֗בוּ וילונו עָלָיו֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לְהוֹצִ֥יא דִבָּ֖ה עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: The men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,
controles.kjv: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
controles.livre: E os homens que Moisés enviou a reconhecer a terra, e depois de voltarem fizeram murmurar contra ele a toda a congregação, desacreditando aquele país,

versos.hebraico: וַיָּמֻ֨תוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים מוֹצִאֵ֥י דִבַּת־הָאָ֖רֶץ רָעָ֑ה בַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.
controles.livre: Aqueles homens que haviam falado mal da terra, morreram de praga diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן וְכָלֵ֖ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֑ה חָיוּ֙ מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הַֽהֹלְכִ֖ים לָת֥וּר אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
controles.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
controles.livre: Mas Josué filho de Num, e Calebe filho de Jefoné, restaram com vida dentre aqueles homens que haviam ido a reconhecer a terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽתְאַבְּל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
controles.kjv: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
controles.livre: E Moisés disse estas coisas a todos os filhos de Israel, e o povo ficou em muito luto.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּֽעֲל֥וּ אֶל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֶּ֗נּוּ וְעָלִ֛ינוּ אֶל־הַמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃

controles.web: They rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised: for we have sinned.”
controles.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.
controles.livre: E levantaram-se pela manhã, e subiram ao cume do monte, dizendo: Eis-nos aqui para subir ao lugar do qual falou o SENHOR; porque pecamos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֛ה אַתֶּ֥ם עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶת־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א תִצְלָֽח׃

controles.web: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?
controles.kjv: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.
controles.livre: E disse Moisés: Por que quebrantais o dito do SENHOR? Isto tampouco vos sucederá bem.

versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תַּעֲל֔וּ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין יְהוָ֖ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּ֣גְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that you not be struck down before your enemies.
controles.kjv: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
controles.livre: Não subais, porque o SENHOR não está em meio de vós, não sejais feridos diante de vossos inimigos.

versos.hebraico: כִּי֩ הָעֲמָלֵקִ֨י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וּנְפַלְתֶּ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־עַל־כֵּ֤ן שַׁבְתֶּם֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃

controles.web: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you shall fall by the sword, because you turned back from following Yahweh, therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”
controles.kjv: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.
controles.livre: Porque os amalequitas e os cananeus estão ali diante de vós, e caireis à espada: pois porquanto vos desviastes de seguir ao SENHOR, por isso não será o SENHOR convosco.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעְפִּ֕לוּ לַעֲל֖וֹת אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַאֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָה֙ וּמֹשֶׁ֔ה לֹא־מָ֖שׁוּ מִקֶּ֥רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, and Moses, didn’t depart out of the camp.
controles.kjv: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
controles.livre: Todavia, se insistiram em subir por cima do monte: mas a arca da aliança do SENHOR, e Moisés, não se apartaram do meio do acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֤רֶד הָעֲמָלֵקִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּהָ֣ר הַה֑וּא וַיַּכּ֥וּם וַֽיַּכְּת֖וּם עַד־הַֽחָרְמָֽה׃פ

controles.web: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.
controles.kjv: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
controles.livre: E desceram os amalequitas e os cananeus, que habitavam naquele monte, e os feriram e os derrotaram, perseguindo-os até Hormá.
